Marina (CEO): Quick update for the week — a few things I want everyone to be aware of and where to focus. TL;DR: finish EU private beta prep, sharpen SLA targets, and tighten data-retention policy.

Jordan (VP Product): Thanks — quick note on the EU private beta: docs are in final review (PR #469), samples for the onboarding flow landed yesterday. We still need 2 walkthroughs from PMs this week.

Sophie (VP Eng): Engineering is aligned on the canary plan. Canary will use 2x dedicated pods in us-west for the first 48h, then expand if latency < 120ms p95. Observability hooks are in place.

Ravi (Head of SRE): Incident recap from last week — noisy prefetch jobs caused KV-cache evictions and a 15m latency spike in the 10:10–10:25 window. Root cause: scheduling jitter after infra rollout. Mitigation deployed: stricter cgroup limits + backoff. Full postmortem in #postmortems by EOD.

Marina (CEO): Appreciate the quick mitigation. Two exec asks: 1) Product & Eng to confirm canary SLO pass/fail criteria by Tue EOD. 2) Ops + Sales to sync on customer comms for any EU beta data policies.

Ana (Head of Sales): Noted. We'll prepare a short FAQ + one-pager for current beta customers. Want to confirm the wording on data-retention shortening from 90→60 days before sending.

Jordan (VP Product): On the retention change — this is a targeted policy for PII-adjacent logs only, not embeddings or usage metrics. We'll publish a clarified policy doc and update the Console wording.

Sophie (VP Eng): Heads-up: to keep costs predictable we recommend enabling prefix caching for the top 25% routes. Redwood Optimize will surface a recommended config next week.

Ravi (Head of SRE): Ops note: Dedicated capacity billing anomaly flagged last billing cycle. Finance + Infra investigating; temporary credit applied for affected customers. Will share details in the billing sync.

Marina (CEO): Metrics snapshot: weekly API requests +12% (growth from one new anchor customer), overall infra error-rate steady at 0.6% but p95 latency up 8% from two weeks ago (we're tracking). Cost per 1M tokens down 3% after quantization tuning.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: commit 9f3a2b4 -> prod; canary started at 1793456900.

Marina (CEO): Asks for the week: 1) Product/Eng finalize canary pass criteria (Jordan/Sophie). 2) SRE & Infra deliver postmortem and preventive checklist (Ravi). 3) Growth & Sales prep customer comms + FAQ (Ana). 4) Docs update for retention policy (Jordan). Office hours Friday 10:00 PT for any clarifying questions.

Sophie (VP Eng): Will have pass criteria and monitoring playbook by Tue noon.

Jordan (VP Product): Docs PR in flight, will tag Marketing for review.

Ravi (Head of SRE): Postmortem draft by tomorrow AM.

Ana (Head of Sales): FAQ draft ready Wednesday; will loop in legal if wording on retention changes.

Marina (CEO): Thanks team — keep escalation channels open and flag anything that risks the canary timeline. :rocket:
